# Prepare the FASTQ dataset

## Download the FASTQ files

Download the complete paired-end FASTQ files from ENA:

```bash
mkdir -p data/fastq

while read -r run base; do
  for mate in 1 2; do
    wget -c "${base}/${run}_${mate}.fastq.gz" -P data/fastq
  done
done <<'EOF'
SRR8281218 https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/008/SRR8281218
SRR8281226 https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/006/SRR8281226
SRR8281245 https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/005/SRR8281245
SRR8281243 https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR828/003/SRR8281243
EOF
```

The output directory contains eight files:

```text
data/fastq/
├── SRR8281218_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR8281218_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR8281226_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR8281226_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR8281243_1.fastq.gz
├── SRR8281243_2.fastq.gz
├── SRR8281245_1.fastq.gz
└── SRR8281245_2.fastq.gz
```

## Check the FASTQ files

```bash
test "$(find data/fastq -maxdepth 1 -name '*.fastq.gz' | wc -l)" -eq 8
gzip -t data/fastq/*.fastq.gz
echo "All eight FASTQ files passed the gzip integrity check."
```

Data source: [NCBI BioProject PRJNA482620](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/bioproject/PRJNA482620), runs [SRR8281218](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/SRR8281218), [SRR8281226](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/SRR8281226), [SRR8281245](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/SRR8281245), and [SRR8281243](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/SRR8281243).
